text:
A transformer in a computer is used to transform the mains voltage of 240V to 12V.
The number of turns on the secondary coil is 2000.
Which statement about the transformer is correct?
A
It is a step-down transformer and has 100 turns on its primary coil.
B
It is a step-down transformer and has 40000 turns on its primary coil.
C
It is a step-up transformer and has 100 turns on its primary coil.
D
It is a step-up transformer and has 40000 turns on its primary coil.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a step-down transformer and has 100 turns on its primary coil.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a step-down transformer and has 40000 turns on its primary coil.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a step-up transformer and has 100 turns on its primary coil.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a step-up transformer and has 40000 turns on its primary coil.
